response.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), ov AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(st.avg_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(st.avg_usage - ov.overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM st, ov WHERE st.avg_usage > ov.overall
